title: Maternal deaths per thousand births: Martha Ballard against hospitals of her century and the United States
description: Bar chart of maternal deaths per 1,000 births, from Table V of Laurel Thatcher Ulrich's A Midwife's Tale. Martha Ballard's deliveries in Hallowell, Maine, 1785 to 1812: 6.1. London lying-in hospital A, 1767 to 1772: 27.5. London hospital B, 1749 to 1770: 21.5. Dublin hospital B, 1757 to 1775: 14.1. The United States in 1930: 6.7, and in 1945: 2.1.
heading: MOTHERS WHO DIED · PER 1,000 BIRTHS
